abstract.t:
This document describes how an OAuth scope value that is an HTTPS URI can be dereferenced to obtain a JSON document describing that scope. The document is descriptive only and does not change the authorization meaning of the scope. Dereferencing follows the pattern and security rules of the OAuth Client ID Metadata Document.
About This Document
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
Discussion of this document takes place on the Web Authorization Protocol Working Group mailing list (mailto:oauth@ietf.org), which is archived at https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/browse/oauth/.
